summary:
I am an Assistant Professor in Department of CS&IT Siksha O Anusandhan University Bhubaneswar, Odisha. I have submitted
Ph.D. thesis in the Department Information Technology, Indian Institute of Information Technology Allahabad, India. I
received M. Tech. Computer Science from National Institute of Technology Rourkela, India. I received B. Tech. Information
Technology from the Biju Patnaik University of Technology Odisha. I am working in the research area of Blockchain, Layer-2
Blockchain, Cryptography, Advance Cryptography, and Network Security. I have 3.8 years of teaching experience and from
which 1.5 years of experience from Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology Allahabad.
